```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(lubridate)
df <- read_csv("healthcare-dataset-stroke-data.csv") |>
# levels for readability
drop_na(age, hypertension) |>
mutate(gender = factor(gender), hypertension = factor(hypertension, levels = c(0, 1),
labels = c("No", "Yes")),
smoking_status = factor(smoking_status),
stroke = factor(stroke, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")))

# Shown instead of a plot when the inputs leave no rows
empty_plot <- function() {
  plotly_empty() |>
    layout(title = list(text = "No passengers match these inputs.", y = 0.5))
}
```

# Plots

## {.sidebar}

The Stroke Prediction dataset contains information about
patients and various health-related characteristics that
may be associated with experiencing a stroke.

Some characteristics include age, gender, hypertension,
heart disease, employment type, and smoking status.

Use the input below to change the categorical variable
displayed in the plots and the data table.

```{r}
selectInput("var", "Choose a variable", choices = c("Gender" = "gender",
"Hypertension" = "hypertension", "Smoking Status" = "smoking_status"))
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Age by the chosen variable
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

```{r}
#| title: Stroke by the chosen variable
plotlyOutput("p2")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Data used in the plots (filtered by the inputs on the Plots page)
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
filtered <- reactive(df)

output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
p <- ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = age, color = .data[[input$var]])) +
    geom_density()
  ggplotly(p)
})

output$p2 <- renderPlotly({
if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
p <- ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = .data[[input$var]], fill = stroke)) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill")
  ggplotly(p)
})

output$tbl <- renderDT({
  filtered() |> 
    select(age, gender, hypertension, smoking_status, stroke) |>
    datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10))
})
```
